source: Pew Research Center. 2014. "Religion in Latin America: Widespread Change in a Historically Catholic Region."
method: Population is respondent's own current religion (QCURRELrec), pooled across all 18 Latin American/Caribbean countries and Puerto Rico. Share answering "yes" to Q60m ("Do you believe that in communion, the bread and wine actually become the body and blood of Christ, or not?"); don't know/refused excluded. Weighted by the dataset's own combined base/post-stratification WEIGHT.
